locations.name: Tram Stop #17

exterior.description: A classic European tram shelter on a cobblestone sidewalk. Glass and metal canopy, weathered bench, faded timetable display dated 1994. A man sits on the bench with pigeons on his shoulders. He has clearly been there a while. A small shrine of offerings surrounds him. Locals walk past without a second glance - they're used to it.

interior.theme: Where patience becomes legend and public transit becomes existential crisis

functions: Get accurate directions to any location in the city
Visit Jiří repeatedly to witness his transformation into local landmark
Complete optional Night Vigil for emotional backstory and Jiří's Blessing buff

connects_to.jiri_note: The metro is for those who have given up.

jiris_blessing_active.effect: +1 Charm with all local NPCs citywide
jiris_blessing_active.recognition_dialogue: You're the Americans who sat with Jiří. Good people.

final_boss_appearance.appearance: Jiří visible in background, still at stop, gives thumbs up

quest_npc_jiri_eternal_commuter.progressive_appearance: 6 visual states based on visit count

information_source_city_directions.description: Jiří knows where everything in the city is and will give accurate directions
information_source_city_directions.quirk: Always mentions that the 17 is an option when it arrives

event_hook_night_vigil.content: Jiří's full backstory, the milk, the ring, the waiting

progressive_visual_jiri_transformation.description: Jiří transforms from eccentric local to civic landmark over visits

buff_source_jiris_blessing.flavor: Locals recognize you as the Americans who sat with Jiří

easter_egg_newspaper_clipping.content: LOCAL MAN VOWS TO WAIT FOR TRAM - dated 2002

easter_egg_missing_poster.content: Missing poster with Jiří's face, word FOUND written across, note: He's at Stop 17

taxi_driver.dialogue: You want Stop 17? That's Jiří's stop. He won't take a taxi. We've offered.

local_shopkeeper.dialogue: My grandmother remembers when Jiří first started waiting. She was a child.

metro_worker.dialogue: The 17 hasn't run since 1999. Don't tell Jiří. It would kill him. Maybe literally.

tour_guide.dialogue: And on your left, you'll see Jiří's Bench. He's been waiting since before the euro.

post_credits_connection.summary: Five years later. The 17 Heritage Line. Jiří on the tram, crying with joy. Returns home with ancient milk. Marie at the door. 'I got the milk.' Reunion.
post_credits_connection.punchline: Jiří and Marie renewed their vows on Tram #17. The tram was six minutes late to the ceremony.
